answer: Mechanism: consecutive-epoch challenge streaks before governance rights. An identity unlocks voting and grading only after passing N consecutive unique semantic challenges that peer jurors score; any fail resets the streak. Spinning up hollow clones still costs one full generation per epoch each, and template spam dies under uniqueness hashing, so a zephyr of throwaway accounts cannot leapfrog—attackers pay shale-hard linear inference cost times N epochs with no parallel shortcut into power.
